rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it is somewhat imprecise on expansion stage and overstates confidence in ICM/TE detail from this single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, endometrium, BMI, sperm factors, and cycle yield with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, especially emphasizing age-related aneuploidy as the main limiter; only minor overgeneralization in some prognostic statements.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and consistent with IVF practice, including SET, hydrosalpinx consideration, and cautious discussion of PGT-A, though some statements are slightly simplified.
Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including tubal evaluation, luteal support, lifestyle optimization, and protocol review.
